end.summary:
Practised top/bottom and on/under using objects and animals.
Used “upar/neeche” accurately in 3 recorded attempts.
Practised left/right and in-front/behind as relative to the person facing.
Left/right was first treated as fixed in the room, then corrected later; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Shaurya practised position words through picture-based questions, including “upar/neeche,” “paas,” and left/right. The method of checking which way a person is facing helped correct the left/right mix-up later in the lesson. At home, place a toy near, far, on, and under another object and ask Shaurya to describe each position.
